description: Learn local balance effects for an articulated body through opaque joint twitches and receipt-backed graph mutation, with reflex, adaptive, and consolidation work on distinct graph-held deadline sheets.

rules.name: ha_recognize_held_body_shape
rules.comment: Warm-start compatibility is ordinary exact-cover ShapeDecode over a name-free kinematic relation system. Controller dynamics are separately exact so a morphology match cannot silently authorize a program learned under different actuation.

rules.name: ha_recognize_late_restored_body_shape
rules.comment: Assimilate an exact shape library that arrived after body ingest. The late memory remains output-null; this only opens normal member rebinding and local verification.

rules.name: ha_mint_novel_body_shape
rules.comment: If no held morphology exactly covers the sensed relation system, mint that residual as a new body-shape codebook entry. The name is only a mechanical identity; novelty is decided by ShapeDecode.

rules.name: ha_open_changed_library_motor_program_shape_audit
rules.comment: Enter ShapeDecode only when the imported program population changed since this program's last deduplication audit.

rules.name: ha_shape_decode_duplicate_library_motor_program
rules.comment: Treat motor programs as relation systems. ShapeDecode, not host tuple comparison, recognizes an imported program already covered by an earlier codebook entry under the same body shape.

rules.name: ha_close_unique_library_motor_program_shape_audit
rules.comment: A zero-residual duplicate search is stable until the library population changes; retain that negative shape evidence.

rules.name: ha_select_active_motor_plan_task_context
rules.comment: The graph changes its plan-search question with the active drive. This recruits takeoff priors only during self-authored takeoff and restores locomotion priors when that drive closes.

rules.name: ha_consider_shape_matched_motor_plan_hint
rules.comment: A plan hint is an output-null relation system. Exact task-shape coverage makes it a cheap default search basin. It does not itself recruit System 2: typed residual/surprise boundaries own that escalation. The hint never selects a token, enacts a program, or marks an action ready.

rules.name: ha_classify_grounded_program_routing_shape
rules.comment: A receipt-grounded program enters the shared routing index by exact equality of its task-context and task-phase relations. The routing node is already the canonical decoded shape: decoding again through non-unique situated program names would add ambiguity and quadratic work without adding evidence. The small relation alphabet avoids the hint-stage by learned-program Cartesian scan while preserving exact body-local identity.

rules.name: ha_request_grounded_program_routing
rules.comment: A newly indexed grounded program recruits only the plan-hint routing sheet. The quadratic shape decoders therefore run at a relevant graph event, never on unrelated motor receipts.

rules.name: ha_classify_grounded_program_consequence_shape
rules.comment: A grounded program joins the observed-motion consequence alphabet by exact integer/string relation equality. Continuous plant measurements remain at the interface; the index holds only their categorical receipt.

rules.name: ha_bind_indexed_bootstrap_stage_basin
rules.comment: A shared routing-shape node indexes each grounded local program once. General hints remain topology/search evidence; only a currently matching observed consequence transition becomes an active composer basin. The edge grants no actuator authority.

rules.name: ha_bind_motor_plan_hint_stage_search_basin
rules.comment: A harvested stage points System 2 to the exact local program ordinal from which it was derived. This indexed identity join is evidence about where to search, never actuator authority.

rules.name: ha_route_abstract_motor_plan_hint_stage_basin
rules.comment: Biological and robotics priors share only task-context and task-phase relations with body-local programs. Their canonical routing-shape index joins abstract stages to improving search basins; exact tokens and actuator authority remain local and receipt-gated.

rules.name: ha_restore_shape_indexed_residual_regime_memory
rules.comment: Restore the graph's completed gait/regime sweep for the recognized body shape so a new lifetime continues the curriculum instead of repeatedly relearning the first walking regimes.

rules.name: ha_bind_warm_motor_program_member
rules.comment: Bind each serialized opaque member fact back onto the current body's phase-conditioned actuator model by graph equality. The loader restores facts only; it never maps or selects actuators.

rules.name: ha_activate_shape_matched_motor_program
rules.comment: A restored program becomes an active prior only after ShapeDecode recognized its body and every opaque member rebound to the present actuator graph. Shape memory retains coordinated population programs rather than body-local singleton habits. A singleton endpoint is admitted only when a recovered whole trajectory verified it. It remains output-null until the normal motor gate releases it.

rules.name: ha_bind_shape_transition_source_endpoint
rules.comment: Resolve one restored transition endpoint before the edge is activated, avoiding a repeated endpoint cross product.

rules.name: ha_activate_shape_matched_motor_transition
rules.comment: Restore a developmental edge only after shape decoding has rebound both endpoint programs to the current body.

rules.name: ha_request_motor_library_consolidation
rules.comment: A newly grounded coordinated program outside active locomotion, or an explicit lifetime boundary, recruits the shared integration task set. Active movement leaves programs in working motor memory so offline shape-library consolidation cannot lengthen the control loop. The slow sheet still decides whether and how the program enters the library; the host supplies no retention policy.

rules.name: ha_mint_shape_indexed_residual_regime_memory
rules.comment: At the explicit lifetime boundary retain explored gait hypotheses under the recognized body shape.

rules.name: ha_update_shape_indexed_residual_regime_memory
rules.comment: Refresh one restored gait hypothesis after another receipt-grounded lifetime.

rules.name: ha_store_grounded_program_by_body_shape
rules.comment: Mint confidence-qualified coordinated programs into the body-shape codebook. At a lifetime boundary select the transferred programs as a repertoire: if their whole embodied trajectory matches or beats the shape's held best, restore individually inhibited chunks from the slow prior. Singleton habits remain lifetime-local.

rules.name: ha_store_verified_motor_transition_by_body_shape
rules.comment: Persist only whole-trajectory-verified developmental edges whose endpoint chunks already belong to the same body shape.

rules.name: ha_withdraw_unsafe_program_from_body_shape_library
rules.comment: Reject invalid structure immediately. An unsafe held compound is inhibited for the current lifetime but remains attached to its repertoire until boundary-level embodied selection decides whether the jointly expressed set improved the shape's trajectory.

rules.name: ha_open_intentional_situated_locomotion_context
rules.comment: When safe developmental intent deliberately opens a non-canonical future path, mint explicit graph ownership of the trajectory. It is not a pose target: the owned trajectory may remain dynamically unbalanced while structural power and thermal limits retain hard-reflex authority.

rules.name: ha_close_intentional_situated_locomotion_context
rules.comment: Withdraw the temporary attractor when deliberate locomotion closes or changes developmental goal. Canonical posture then regains authority without deleting the contextual receipt.

rules.name: ha_measure_raw_humanoid_balance
rules.comment: Measure vestibular and height state directly. A body below its graph-held upright envelope recruits recovery from raw perception unless the situated developmental graph is deliberately learning locomotion in that configuration. A discovered crawl or cruise basin is not a fall merely because it is not upright.

rules.name: ha_resume_lifetime_after_mechanical_body_reset
rules.comment: Consume a reset receipt only after the graph requested a new get-up attempt. Clear transient control state while preserving all learned action, program, transition, and recovery models.

rules.name: ha_measure_directed_locomotion_and_support
rules.comment: Measure directed travel and alternating unilateral support from raw graph-mirrored state.

rules.name: ha_hold_deliberate_task_controller_authority
rules.comment: An upright body executing a deliberate takeoff keeps the task controller active. Walking recovery is a competing controller, not a fault handler; it may pre-empt only after a body-limit verdict.

rules.name: ha_initialize_body_scaled_response_horizon
rules.comment: Derive the initial motor horizon from the body's measured gravity-fall time, physics clock, and discovered actuator dimensionality; no host command-rate constant participates.

rules.name: ha_focus_topology_sensitive_response_horizon
rules.comment: Supported ballistic tasks focus proprioceptive sampling by the discovered actuator dimensionality. The graph preserves the selected action and scales its predicted consequence to the shorter hold, allowing contact loss and momentum sign changes to be observed before a new synthesis. One physics receipt is the irreducible floor, not a controller-rate constant.

rules.name: ha_choose_opaque_joint_babble
rules.comment: Systematically twitch each opaque non-tonic actuator.

rules.name: ha_initialize_support_phase_action_model
rules.comment: Graph-initialize each support-conditioned model from its verified posture-local parent model.

rules.name: ha_initialize_compound_synergy_prior
rules.comment: Initialize a compatible pair with the explicit additive prediction of its two independently receipt-learned parents.

rules.name: ha_choose_staged_synergy_probe
rules.comment: From a reset posture, probe the untested compatible pair with the smallest predicted additive body effect at a contracted horizon.

rules.name: ha_retire_ready_motor_authority_at_request_boundary
rules.comment: Ready is one-request output authority, never persistent memory state. A newer sensed request expires an unconsumed edge; a previously learned program remains grounded evidence, while an unreceipted synthesis is retained only as superseded analysis.

rules.name: ha_release_selected_developmental_order_n_trajectory
rules.comment: The motor executor consumes a System-2-selected path before ordinary recovery or locomotion can commit the request. Each collapse releases one grounded program through the existing exact trial and receipt machinery.

rules.name: ha_choose_learned_balance_twitch
rules.comment: Project measured angular velocity over the body's gravity-derived fall timescale and choose the learned opaque twitch with minimum predicted body-axis departure.

rules.name: ha_account_recovery_mode_entry
rules.comment: Count the actual graph state transition into recovery, independent of whether vestibular prediction, contact loss, or the shared sensorimotor interrupt authored it.

rules.name: ha_mint_situated_recovery_basin
rules.comment: On entry to fallen-body recovery, anchor a temporary basin to the sensed configuration and dimensionless body state. The basin is a situated search frame, not a canonical posture.

rules.name: ha_recall_shape_indexed_recovery_basin_hint
rules.comment: A settled fallen body first restricts recall to useful stored basins with both a concrete causal action receipt and a successor launch manifold containing the live receipt; within that structural frontier it recalls the closest height/alignment basin. If no successor is currently admissible, the closest useful basin remains the fallback. A transient falling sample is not an indexing frame. The recalled basin is only a search hint: its action must earn a fresh receipt from the present configuration and load.

rules.name: ha_settle_candidate_recovery_basin
rules.comment: The first fallen sample is not yet a stable posture. Hold it as a candidate until a verified receipt shows dissipating motion or increased support, then anchor the basin to that sensed state without inventing a home configuration.

rules.name: ha_retire_current_recovery_basin_on_viability
rules.comment: Retire a fallen-body basin only from a newer raw-state receipt that establishes viability, or from an acknowledged body reset. A stale upright flag from before the probe cannot erase the experimental recovery frame.

rules.name: ha_update_condition_terminated_recovery_program
rules.comment: Keep an option open while fresh receipts remain on its non-dominated successor approach; otherwise terminate it.

rules.name: ha_exit_gait_recovery_inside_learned_envelope
rules.comment: Release the postural controller once vestibular tilt is back inside the learned gait envelope and downward centre-of-mass motion has been arrested. This returns authority at a receipt-backed viability boundary rather than demanding an average pose.

rules.name: ha_request_new_get_up_attempt_after_impasse
rules.comment: After the complete opaque actuator alphabet has been tried and a further alphabet-length interval produces no recovery improvement, declare a graph-level get-up impasse. The mechanical boundary may reset the body, but the learned graph persists.

rules.name: ha_route_recalled_recovery_successor
rules.comment: When a warm lifetime reproduces a retained transition, route its new live basin to the stored successor frontier. The stored actions remain hints and require fresh receipts.

rules.name: ha_test_recalled_recovery_path_transition
rules.comment: Test the compound that caused a retained successor edge when each live height, alignment, support, contact, and motion coordinate either lies within that transition's receipt-defined launch span or its one-step stored delta strictly reduces residual to the successor. This is projected path-shape math, not an exact pose or scalar tolerance. It remains a hint: the present body and load must provide a fresh receipt.

rules.name: ha_test_prior_recovery_basin_hint
rules.comment: A newly promoted recovery basin tests the best positive action from its predecessor once as an output-null warm-start hint. The new basin receives its own receipt; prior effects are not copied as facts about the new body state.

rules.name: ha_reanchor_between_situated_recovery_probes
rules.comment: After a local singleton probe displaces a retained recovery posture, replay the receipt-backed option that established that basin before probing another opaque effector. The basin is an observed experimental frame, not a canonical body pose; fresh receipts terminate an unsuccessful return.

rules.name: ha_explore_situated_recovery_basin
rules.comment: Explore the opaque actuator alphabet again after a receipt-confirmed change of recovery basin. Effects are local to the current body state instead of being smeared across all falls.

rules.name: ha_stabilize_before_recovery_composition
rules.comment: After the local actuator survey, hold the present situated configuration while receipts show useful damping. This co-contraction stage separates settling from inverse-recruited postural movement without a clock or canonical pose.

rules.name: ha_select_recovery_composition_primary
rules.comment: Bind the context-selected Pareto primary once so the compound chooser avoids a Cartesian action-pair expansion.

rules.name: ha_compose_situated_recovery_action
rules.comment: After local singleton exploration, combine the two best receipt-backed effectors from different mechanical groups. Each firing keeps the body-derived nominal horizon; the open recovery program, rather than a second duration mechanism, controls persistence.

rules.name: ha_explore_whole_body_get_up_action
rules.comment: When fallen, systematically try the entire opaque actuator alphabet. This includes arm, trunk, and leg actuators when the body has them, without supplying anatomical labels to the graph. This is the pre-basin fallback; once a situated recovery basin exists, its local explorer exclusively owns the decision fields.

rules.name: ha_exploit_learned_whole_body_get_up_action
rules.comment: Before a situated basin exists, repeat the action whose verified receipts best increased normalized height and body vertical alignment. Basin-local exploitation exclusively owns later choices.

rules.name: ha_select_gait_recovery_primary
rules.comment: Select the learned primary balance correction before collapsing the still-open locomotion and recovery residuals through the shared arbitrary-width motor-program synthesis. This controller owns upright instability; once the body is classified fallen, the situated get-up manifold exclusively owns motor selection.

rules.name: ha_curiosity_selects_coordination_experiment
rules.comment: After a receipt window, evaluate decision_core's own graph-held curiosity score over coordination hypotheses. Prediction residual is cost, unresolved structure is asymmetry, and compressible learning progress is novelty.

rules.name: ha_select_pareto_persistent_residual_regime
rules.comment: After the graph completes its sweep, reject dominated regimes across progress, path, balance, support and energy. Current graph-held need focuses one frontier dimension without scalarizing or weighting unlike objectives.

rules.name: ha_clear_stale_shared_walking_primary
rules.comment: A primary-ready latch belongs to the request that authored it. Clear a prior request's unconsumed latch before the shared collapse is prepared; no later program may consume that primary under a newer sensor epoch.

rules.name: ha_prepare_shared_walking_primary
rules.comment: Expose only support- and state-local primitive experts. Their grounded value is the negated existing whole-body walking cost; the shared collapse chooses the primary without body-specific logic.

rules.name: ha_retire_inactive_shared_walking_primary
rules.comment: Remove phase/context experts that are no longer local before the next atomic collapse; they remain learned graph memory.

rules.name: ha_arm_shared_walking_primary
rules.comment: Arm primary competition only when every currently local phase model carries a grounded value from this sensor epoch.

rules.name: ha_release_shared_walking_primary
rules.comment: Translate the exact shared verdict into the existing analysis-by-synthesis primary slot. Program recall, arbitrary compound expansion, reflexes, and recovery retain their own graph pathways.

rules.name: ha_select_learned_walking_primary
rules.comment: Select the primary learned twitch before independently searching for a compatible simultaneous movement.

rules.name: ha_prepare_verified_takeoff_stage
rules.comment: F-16-style stage firing for a recovered takeoff schema: each whole-trajectory-verified population stage competes from its own current support-topology precondition instead of waiting for an ordinal predecessor or matching the walking primitive selector's primary token. Duration comes from the stage receipt or its verified outgoing temporal edge, allowing a compound schema root to fire without inventing a host-side or magic-number horizon. Compression keeps these defaults output-null so analysis by synthesis can construct a different realization.

rules.name: ha_advance_grounded_motor_sequence
rules.comment: Treat the last safe output-potent population state as temporal context. Follow the best grounded outgoing transition only when its conditional forward model beats the best primitive in the present body state. The receipt-updated graph, not Python, advances the motor trajectory.

rules.name: ha_release_prepared_motor_sequence
rules.comment: Release one prepared temporal successor through the same direct/indirect gate while preserving its predecessor-conditioned forward model and timing coordinate.

rules.name: ha_reassociate_grounded_motor_memory
rules.comment: Keep grounded population programs output-null until one fits the present support context and predicts lower task error than the best primitive. A transferred default that earned its local verification receipt remains a System-1 default while its exact memory updates online. Release that existing cortical-style repertoire state without reconstruction or host selection.

rules.name: ha_release_prepared_motor_memory
rules.comment: Model thalamic disinhibition as a distinct graph event: the direct task advantage releases an output-null preparation only after paying its receipt-learned indirect uncertainty cost.

rules.name: ha_materialize_generic_learning_safety_context
rules.comment: Publish graph-owned recovery evidence before the native future-manifold gate evaluates a candidate. Exploration budgets are ceilings: current support, load, pose, recovery latency and horizon determine the dimension-specific fraction actually available.

rules.name: ha_choose_learned_walking_twitch
rules.comment: Collapse every currently open motor residual into one graph-native outcome. Ordinary locomotion begins from its best support-conditioned primitive; upright recovery begins from the support-conditioned correction selected by the same forward models. The one motor-program node may recruit arbitrary effectors and is later grounded as a reusable compound rather than multiplexing two independent commands.

rules.name: ha_resume_yielded_motor_program_synthesis
rules.comment: A mechanical scheduler may deliver the declared resume edge; only the graph clears its yield state and reopens synthesis.

rules.name: ha_open_persistent_compound_curiosity_selection
rules.comment: Persistent task residual opens an explicit candidate comparison lease; ordinary fixpoints do not join the full phase alphabet to every building program.

rules.name: ha_curiosity_selects_persistent_singleton_compound
rules.comment: When a smaller assembly repeatedly leaves its task residual open, choose the compatible next effector with least receipt experience. Locomotion uses confirmed prediction surprise; a self-takeoff task uses a complete failed developmental evidence window. The candidate alphabet, independent effector groups, context and receipt-backed pair compatibility all come from the graph. Support and load remain learned tradeoffs unless a material interrupt is present; there is no body-specific width or action-count schedule.

rules.name: ha_close_empty_compound_curiosity_selection
rules.comment: An empty compatible alphabet is negative evidence for this request and is reconsidered when the sensed request advances.

rules.name: ha_curiosity_expands_exact_compound_program
rules.comment: Commit the selected compatible effector into one exact order-N intervention. The ordinary receipt path then grounds the whole nonlinear program and refines every exact pair residual.

rules.name: ha_abs_expand_motor_program
rules.comment: Analysis-by-synthesis matching pursuit: add the independent primitive whose forward-synthesized body consequence most reduces residual error. Strict improvement and one primitive per discovered actuator group make arbitrary-width search finite.

rules.name: ha_abs_close_motor_program_at_synthesis_fixpoint
rules.comment: Close the arbitrary motor program exactly when no remaining independent primitive improves its forward synthesis. Compound programs use the causally calibrated pair-probe horizon.

rules.name: ha_project_least_takeoff_effort_inside_future_manifold
rules.comment: After member synthesis, derive the target-to-predicted recruitment ratio and use it only when the complete scaled held program remains inside every foveated manifold bound. Unsupported or escaping proposals retain normal unit effort.

rules.name: ha_choose_tonic_posture_control
rules.comment: Matched control arm selects only the body's tonic default.

rules.name: ha_open_receipt_advanced_motor_sequence_trial
rules.comment: Make one learned transition output-potent. The new trial links both the stable subprogram and the conditional transition state so its receipt can update the exact temporal model.

rules.name: ha_open_reassociated_motor_memory_trial
rules.comment: Convert one graph-selected output-null motor memory into an output-potent trial. The trial is a new causal event while its arbitrary member set remains on the grounded repertoire node.

rules.name: ha_bind_synthesized_structure_to_canonical_memory
rules.comment: Analysis by synthesis still authors the exact action. If that structure already has a safe grounded population memory, enact the stable node and credit its receipt instead of creating another request-identity memory. The current synthesis, not memory prediction, supplies actuator authority.

rules.name: ha_open_synthesized_motor_program_trial
rules.comment: Open an arbitrary bundle trial from the program's own member edges. This structural dependency makes the fixpoint incrementally visible without a host-side pump.

rules.name: ha_open_receipt_backed_motor_trial
rules.comment: Commit the graph-selected opaque action against the body-derived mechanical topology. Distinct tokens for the same actuator group collapse to the primary singleton, so concurrent proposal settlement cannot author contradictory joint commands.

rules.name: ha_link_compound_trial_to_synergy_model
rules.comment: Link only the live issued trial.  The token index binds its exact first-member synergy before the second member is verified, so retained motor history cannot turn this into a trial-by-synergy Cartesian scan.

rules.name: ha_measure_gait_prediction_error_and_interrupt
rules.comment: Compare each verified horizontal velocity consequence with the active support-phase model. Learn the largest normal residual and vestibular tilt range during familiarization; interrupt immediately on a structural power or thermal verdict. Outside an intentionally owned developmental trajectory, excessive tilt or persistent prediction surprise also recruits recovery.

rules.name: ha_specialize_surprising_support_phase_context
rules.comment: A surprising single-action receipt creates a new local forward-model expert anchored to its exact pre-action configuration and body state. Configuration identity selects an expert but does not by itself prove that another expert is needed; measured context distance supplies that evidence.

rules.name: ha_confirm_local_phase_prediction_from_receipt
rules.comment: A verified, identifiable receipt confirms a local model when predicted and observed motion have the same sign relative to the currently requested heading. Confirmation is integer evidence, not elapsed-time freshness.

rules.name: ha_invalidate_stale_local_phase_prediction
rules.comment: An identifiable verified receipt whose directed-motion sign contradicts the issued prediction immediately withdraws that local model's selection authority. No clock, timeout, fixed residual tolerance, or Python policy participates.

rules.name: ha_reground_invalidated_local_phase_prediction
rules.comment: The same contradictory verified receipt re-anchors the bounded local expert in place. Authority returns only after every consequence and context anchor has been replaced by that receipt; no unbounded expert population or host-side retraining is introduced.

rules.name: ha_tune_response_horizon_from_prediction_receipt
rules.comment: Contract the motor hold horizon for grounded prediction or vestibular recovery. With no aerodynamic effector, an already aerial body instead retains the body/gravity-derived nominal horizon until contact returns; stable grounded receipts then relax one physics frame at a time toward that same horizon.

rules.name: ha_tune_compound_movement_interval
rules.comment: Use the learned gait envelope and exact task receipt as a reversible interaction schedule. Unsafe or unproductive surprise inhibits the rejected program but only spaces global exploration by the body-derived confirmation horizon; it cannot exponentially suppress unrelated combinations. Safe forward surprise returns to the body-derived baseline so its causal model can become precise.

rules.name: ha_learn_persistent_residual_regime
rules.comment: Attribute exact progress, path, balance, support and energy receipts to the active graph-held residual/viability regime. A body-derived receipt window closes without Python scoring or tuning.

rules.name: ha_learn_opaque_joint_consequence
rules.comment: Learn local body-axis and angular-rate effects only from verified pre/post simulator receipts.

rules.name: ha_learn_compound_interaction_residual
rules.comment: Credit the reset-isolated compound receipt to its exact pair, store observed non-additive residuals, and approve only pairs inside the single-action safety envelope.

rules.name: ha_learn_support_phase_consequence_online
rules.comment: Update a primitive forward model only from an identifiable single-member receipt. Multi-member residuals stay on their exact motor program instead of being smeared across underdetermined causes.

rules.name: ha_learn_identifiable_pair_program_residual
rules.comment: A two-member receipt has one identifiable interaction term, so refine that exact reusable pair residual online. Wider program residuals remain whole-program facts until an intervention can disambiguate their higher-order causes.  The first-member token index keeps unrelated retained synergies outside this receipt-local learning pass.

rules.name: ha_update_reassociated_motor_memory
rules.comment: A recalled population program receives its own exact sensory consequence. Update the stable repertoire trajectory as a whole and withdraw it from output-potent recall after a material viability breach rather than treating situated pose, support or load tradeoffs as faults or misassigning error to members.

rules.name: ha_consolidate_equivalent_motor_program
rules.comment: Structurally identical analysis-by-synthesis programs share one canonical population memory. Credit the verified duplicate receipt to that memory and rewire temporal learning to the stable node instead of fragmenting experience by request identity. The same situated/material receipt viability predicate governs initial, recalled and consolidated memory authority.

rules.name: ha_finish_arbitrary_program_credit_assignment
rules.comment: Close one walking receipt only after every eligible motor-program member has received its share of the residual.

rules.name: ha_ground_synthesized_motor_program_from_receipt
rules.comment: Retain the exact arbitrary program and its nonlinear whole-bundle residual as a grounded analysis-by-synthesis record.

rules.name: ha_break_motor_sequence_on_task_context_change
rules.comment: A deliberate jump and ordinary locomotion are distinct temporal schemas. Clear the predecessor when the active drive changes so a walking chunk cannot become the first phase of a jump.

rules.name: ha_request_motor_sequence_consolidation
rules.comment: A novel receipt-confirmed compound successor recruits the existing embodied integration sheet. The fast sheet identifies the consolidation opportunity; the background sheet alone authors the durable transition.

rules.name: ha_update_grounded_motor_sequence_transition
rules.comment: A safe verified compound receipt advances the temporal context and updates the exact predecessor-conditioned consequence. This learns a trajectory transition rather than smearing the receipt over either endpoint.

rules.name: ha_consolidate_motor_sequence_transition
rules.comment: Consolidate a new edge between consecutive safe compound population states. Its initial forward model is the observed successor receipt; a later independent occurrence must measure its prediction error before graph-native reassociation can release it.

rules.name: ha_invalidate_unsafe_motor_sequence_transition
rules.comment: An unsafe compound receipt makes the exact temporal edge output-null and breaks its active trajectory context.

rules.name: ha_break_unsafe_motor_sequence_context
rules.comment: Break a high-level compound trajectory after an unsafe receipt even when that exact transition has never been seen before.

rules.name: ha_prime_motor_sequence_from_verified_receipt
rules.comment: The first safe compound receipt establishes an output-potent temporal context. Later compound receipts can then consolidate graph edges from this state.

rules.name: ha_break_motor_sequence_on_recovery
rules.comment: Recovery changes the control regime, so the previously active locomotor trajectory is no longer valid temporal context.

rules.name: ha_close_phase_adaptation_after_alphabet_quiet
rules.comment: Close online specialization after no new contextual receipt for more decisions than the support-conditioned actuator alphabet.

rules.name: ha_audit_recovery_successor_promotion
rules.comment: Record the independent receipt-grounded reasons a recovery program can or cannot name a successor basin. This rule is output-null diagnostic evidence and grants no motor or promotion authority.

rules.name: ha_promote_receipt_confirmed_recovery_basin
rules.comment: Promote a new situated recovery basin only when a receipt-confirmed compound's total effect from its program launch crosses the current posture boundary. The boundary receipt need not itself improve a coordinate: requiring that would make a multi-tick program unable to name a state reached after an earlier dynamic step. Dynamic intermediate states are path shape, not noise: normalized motion energy is retained on the successor and fresh replay must remain inside its launch manifold. Singleton receipts remain local affordance evidence, so transient support changes cannot restart the alphabet survey. A changed decoded configuration must cross a postural coordinate. Lower motion alone updates the present basin instead of fragmenting it. Action dominance controls command reuse but cannot erase a newly observed body state; transition energy and peak load stay on the path for later Pareto choice, while the non-dominated action frontier remains the source of reusable commands. This prevents one slowly settling posture from fragmenting into many basins while leaving intermediate recovery milestones unnamed.

rules.name: ha_store_recovery_basin_by_body_shape
rules.comment: At the explicit lifetime boundary, retain situated recovery basins with either a receipt-positive local action or a confirmed successor edge under the already decoded body shape. A path origin is causal evidence even when its opening action is locally dominated; path value and one-step value are not the same objective. This reuses the motor library's morphology index instead of introducing a canonical home pose.

rules.name: ha_learn_whole_body_get_up_consequence
rules.comment: Credit each fallen-body recovery receipt to the exact opaque actuator that caused it. Height and body-axis alignment are raw consequences; no arm, leg, or posture semantics are supplied.

rules.name: ha_request_primitive_motor_learning
rules.comment: A verified primitive twitch recruits only the shared adaptive-learning sheet. Support-phase trials enter the full shared multimodal receipt lifecycle; calibration twitches do not mint an unbounded efference/evidence population.

rules.name: ha_expose_motor_decision_option
rules.comment: Initialize domain-neutral fields without exposing a base model as a current option. Support-conditioned phase experts author the grounded options used for learned walking-primary competition.

rules.name: ha_mint_situated_motor_fixation
rules.comment: Treat a supported quiet configuration as a temporary experimental fixation. It is a sensed, strictly local platform.

rules.name: ha_refresh_situated_motor_fixation
rules.comment: Repeatedly sensing the same stable configuration adds confidence to that local fixation without inventing an origin.

rules.name: ha_reanchor_motor_fixation_after_fixture_reset
rules.comment: A declared mechanical reset invalidates the old local frame but preserves learned models; the sensed stable fixture becomes the new situated reference without implying a universal origin.

rules.name: ha_propose_situated_motor_fixation
rules.comment: A single quiet observation proposes a candidate basin; it cannot move the active motor reference yet.

rules.name: ha_refresh_candidate_motor_fixation
rules.comment: Repeated stable observations accumulate evidence for a candidate without changing command authority.

rules.name: ha_reject_stale_candidate_motor_fixation
rules.comment: A different later configuration breaks settlement and removes the candidate's promotion authority.

rules.name: ha_transition_situated_motor_fixation
rules.comment: Promote a repeatedly settled candidate while retaining the transition from the previous local motor frame.

rules.name: ha_bind_situated_motor_reference
rules.comment: Resolve an issued command around the graph's current stable fixation. The reference is local, replaceable, and explicit.

rules.name: ha_issue_situated_motor_efference_copy
rules.comment: Bind each issued motor trial to the stable configuration from which it was generated, as the motor analogue of a saccade copy.

rules.name: ha_confirm_situated_motor_efference_copy
rules.comment: A later mechanical receipt confirms the issued copy and records both its expected displacement and reference residual.
